def fact_ids_for_date(result):
    fact_ids = []
    bs = result.get("bikram_sambat")
    if isinstance(bs, dict):
        try:
            year = int(bs["year"])
            month = int(bs["month"])
            day = int(bs["day"])
            fact_ids.append(bs_ad_fact_id(year, month, day))
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    return fact_ids
